title: Order of the open cuts, after the agents re-cut
situation: Decision 0036's order is spent: cut 6, agent launch and the re-cut are realized, and cut 2 is folded into the execution cut (0054, 0055). Every cut since cut 3 needed several architect rulings on checks that bound what their examples never fixed (0043).
decision: Cut 5, check quality (0026, 0043), with context subjects (0056) in parallel; then the execution cut (0055); then the delivery cut (0029, 0040); then a consumer trial, kino on a film-production project, before dev is released to main; then cut 7, meaning roles (0028); then the ipseic discovery round (0048).
consequences: The operator approved this order on 2026-10-10. Only the integration step installs onto the operator's host; a cut's lead never installs from an unreleased branch.
